answers.core: This relates to how the engine manages addons.
answers.workaround: Well you can choose to mix up everything inside a single `EditorPlugin`, but if it's a big one it will follow you during the whole development of your addon, eventually becoming a mess. And the uniqueness of some `EditorPlugin` features still cannot be solved. See also above a script attempt at encapsulating it.

title: Allow addons to contain more than one EditorPlugin
